topics.name: Transcripts
topics.description: Academic records issued and exchanged between institutions.

valueDrivers.name: Student mobility
valueDrivers.description: Students move between institutions without losing credit for what they have learned.

useCase.title: Send a transcript to another institution
useCase.description: A student asks their institution to send an official transcript to the institution they are transferring to.
useCase.precondition: The student has completed at least one term.
useCase.trigger: The student requests a transcript be sent.
useCase.guarantees: The receiving institution has a complete, verifiable record of the student's courses, credits and GPA.

userStories.title: Request a transcript
userStories.statement: As a student I want to request my transcript be sent so that I can transfer.
acceptanceCriteria: The request identifies the student and the receiving institution.

data.note: Person Identifier of the requesting student

userStories.title: Assemble the transcript
userStories.statement: As a registrar I want to assemble the student's courses and totals so that the record is complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Cumulative credits and GPA are included.

userStories.title: Receive the transcript
userStories.statement: As the receiving system I want to load the transcript so that transfer credit can be evaluated.
acceptanceCriteria: The student is matched or created from the identifier and name.

transitions.rationale: Stories cover the full exchange and every data point is tied to CEDS.
